name: fg-todo-manager
description: FG To-Do-Manager – multi-tenant Kanban to-do management

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @fg/server && npm run build -w @fg/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fg/server" "npm run dev -w @fg/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @fg/server && npm run typecheck -w @fg/web
scripts.test: npm run test:sqlite && npm run test:pg && npm run test:web
scripts.test:sqlite: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @fg/server -- --project sqlite
scripts.test:pg: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @fg/server -- --project pg
